plans.note: Only the preamble is exposed in the outline; a limitation of liability article is standard in an MSA of this type. Scan the full text for "Limitation of Liability", "consequential", "aggregate liability" and check cap size, mutuality and carve-outs (confidentiality, IP indemnity, gross negligence, willful misconduct).

No indemnity section visible in the outline. Confirm against full text (search "indemnify", "hold harmless", "defend"); if truly absent, add Kubient IP/misconduct indemnity in favour of AP and keep any AP indemnity narrow.
Restrictive covenants on AP are unlikely in a services MSA and none appear in the outline. Verify by searching "non-compete", "shall not engage", "competing" before concluding absence.
No exclusivity heading visible. Check the services/scope and fee provisions for "exclusive", "sole provider", "all of Customer's requirements" language binding AP.
No pricing or MFN heading visible. If an MFN appears in the fees/commercial terms, confirm direction — favourable to AP is acceptable; an obligation for AP to give Kubient best terms is not.

No non-solicit visible in the outline; often sits near confidentiality or general provisions. Search "solicit", "employ", "hire" and check mutuality, duration and a general-advertising carve-out if present.

Term/termination provisions are almost certainly present but not surfaced in the outline; "Initial Term" is a defined term. Locate the termination article and check AP's right to terminate for convenience on notice without penalty and whether Kubient has a symmetric right mid-term.
"Initial Term" is defined, so a renewal mechanic likely follows. Check auto-renewal length, non-renewal notice window (target 30 days or less) and any uncapped uplift on renewal pricing.

Governing law/venue is standard in general provisions though not visible in the outline. Confirm the chosen law is NY, DE, CA or England and Wales and that disputes go to courts rather than foreign arbitration.

Assignment clauses typically sit in the miscellaneous article. Verify AP may assign to affiliates and successors without consent and that Kubient has no termination or consent right on AP's change of control.

An MSA with AP will address ownership of deliverables and data, likely in a proprietary rights article not shown in the outline. Confirm AP owns deliverables and AP data/content, with no assignment or broad licence of AP IP to Kubient.

Check any licence grant to AP (platform/technology access) for affiliate and contractor coverage and delete any "revocable at Licensor's discretion" language; also check whether the grant to Kubient over AP content is properly limited.
No audit heading in the outline. Search "audit", "inspect", "records"; if an audit right against AP exists, apply frequency limits, prior notice, off-site review and Kubient bearing its own costs.
No damages/penalty heading visible. Review fees and termination provisions for early-termination fees, "liquidated damages" or "penalty" payable by AP; service credits running to AP are acceptable.

Warranty and disclaimer language is standard but not surfaced. Confirm a performance/services warranty of meaningful duration with a repair-or-refund remedy, and resist an "AS IS" disclaimer of all warranties.

No insurance article appears in the outline. Confirm by searching "insurance", "coverage", "certificate"; if absent, add commercial general liability, professional liability/E&O and cyber coverage given Kubient's handling of AP data.
No fees or commitment heading visible. Review the commercial terms and any exhibit for minimum spend, take-or-pay or volume floors on AP and require an exit if present.

No effects-of-termination or transition provision visible. Search "upon termination", "return", "transition"; if absent, add data return/deletion in a usable format and reasonable wind-down assistance at agreed rates.
